splashTagline: Before, during, and after the trip with AI, group tools, and memories.
slide1Subtitle: Saved a destination, saw a video, or got a tip? The app turns that idea into a simple plan to follow.
slide2Title: Travel with the group in control.
slide2Subtitle: During the trip, everyone sees the plan, splits bills, meets up, and keeps info out of scattered chats.
slide2Benefit2: Camera reads prices, receipts, and converts currency
slide2Benefit3: Expenses go to the group and split automatically
slide3Subtitle: Photos, places, expenses, and stories become an organized album to keep, replay, and share without losing quality.
tourCreateBody: Tap + to create a trip, log an expense, or open FEFAI.
tourUtilitiesBody: Find restrooms and luggage storage, convert currency, and check the weather while traveling.
tourMemoriesBody: Original-quality photos, your lived map, journal, and recap stay together here.
setupTitle: Let's make this trip space yours
setupSubtitle: It takes less than a minute. Then you can create a trip, invite friends, and use FEFAI.
setupLanguageDescription: The app, dates, and messages use the language you travel with.
setupDestinationDescription: FEFAI uses your destination, dates, and style to suggest a real itinerary.
setupGroupDescription: Group chat, expenses, checklist, and photos stay in the same space.
setupLocationDescription: Check-ins and your lived map only work with consent and can be paused.
notificationTitle: Stay on top of the trip
notificationSubtitle: Notifications that matter: invites, tasks, itinerary, check-ins, and plan changes.
notificationInvitesDescription: Know right away when someone invites you to plan together.
notificationTasksDescription: Keep passports, insurance, stays, and pending items organized.
notificationCheckinsDescription: Important trip updates, always with consent.
